name: ASH - Archie's School House LLC

reviews.text: If I could give one thousand stars, I would. From the very first contact via phone, I could tell that Bianca and Anthony were amazing, skilled, caring professionals. Even though I hadn’t yet signed on with ASH, they spent a lot of time learning about our Frank and our challenges. From the first minutes, my very high-energy, dominant, reactive rescue pittie mix was calm, attentive, and eager to learn in their presence. Understanding that each dog and owner is different, they design an individualized learning program that is right for your dog and family’s needs. Despite having had dogs my entire life, I realized that I have everything to learn—structure and rules make for a more balanced dog and THAT is the biggest proof of love you can give your dog. They give it to you straight and hold you accountable. They provide you with the guidance and support to be successful, but expect you to put in the work with your dog. Without Bianca and Anthony, I do believe we would have had to return Frank to the shelter. We still have so much work to do, but the progress we have made is truly astounding. I love my dog more than anything and know that Bianca and Anthony have dedicated their lives to helping dogs and their owners. The relationship they are able to establish with dogs so quickly is proof of that.  I trust them completely and am eternally grateful for them…even when they point out that I’m the problem :)
reviews.author: Gina Donato

reviews.text: About a year ago, I contacted ASH about our dog Journey.  He was abandoned on streets.   I found he was deaf and had some anxiety issues where he would get aggressive out of nowhere.  I thought we were going to have to give him up.  We had no where left to turn and I contacted Anthony and Biancia.  They are amazing.  They taught us how to interact with Journey and gave us all the tools we needed to make him apart of our family.  I am so grateful for all they do.   They are passionate and care about all of the dogs they work with.  I could not recommend better people to work with.
reviews.author: James Savage

reviews.text: Bianca & Anthony are the absolute best!!!  We were referred to them by a friend when we were looking for help with our pup, Lukin, who likes to run off on his own adventures leaving us to chase him for an hour at a time.  Bianca & Anthony take into account your dog, your living situation, who is doing the training, and the specifics of YOUR dog when training.  They constantly preach about the important of positive reinforcement which is huge for me.  We are now doing weekly group classes focusing on impulse control and  is making great progress!  It’s now enjoyable to walk him and even my 8 year old can walk him when before that was impossible.  I can’t recommend or thank ASH enough, and when we get a new puppy they’ll be on call from day one!
reviews.author: Kimberly Delaney

reviews.text: These people are angels. Helped me w a situation that was extremely sad. They know what they’re doing w aggressive behavior. I would recommend these people with high ratings. They saved my life. Their compassion and understanding of dog behavior is amazing. Can’t say enough.
reviews.author: Diane

reviews.text: Our 8 month old cane corso has done a complete 360 since working with ASH. Before we met Bianca & Anthony we were on the verge of giving up. After one session they gave me hope & support when no one else did. Bianca & Anthony are amazing at what they do. Their expertise and knowledge is unmatched. Kastor still has a long way to go, & I look forward to this journey with you guys by my side. Thank you for all you do!
reviews.author: kenna hughes
